Game Overview

Train Bandit is a adventure game built around become a daring outlaw in Train Bandit, an exhilarating Wild West adventure. Leap between trains, dodge bullets, and outsmart sheriffs while amassing gold in a chaotic race against time. With endless mode's survival challenge and an electrifying soundtrack, every moment keeps you on the edge.
